translations.idiomatic: The five servitude grades were annotated for term-limited labor; two-thousand-li exile meant six years' work, two-thousand-five-hundred-li eight years, three-thousand-li ten years, and all deportation twelve years.

sentences.zh: 收贖則根據婦女贖罪新章酌減銀數，改為通例。

translations.literal: Statutory commutation, drawing on the new regulations for women's offense commutation, reduced the silver amounts after deliberation and made this the general rule.
translations.idiomatic: Statutory commutation rates were reduced following the new women's commutation regulations and applied as a general rule.

sentences.zh: 罰刑照應罰之數折半收贖，徒一年贖銀十兩，每等加銀二兩五錢，至徒三年收贖銀二十兩。

translations.literal: Fine penalties permitted statutory commutation at half the amount due; one year of servitude commuted for ten taels of silver, each grade adding two taels five mace, up to three years of servitude at twenty taels.
translations.idiomatic: Fines could be commuted at half the assessed amount; one year's servitude required ten taels, each grade adding two taels five mace, up to twenty taels for three years.

sentences.zh: 流刑每等加銀五兩，至三千里贖銀三十五兩。

translations.literal: For exile each grade added five taels of silver, up to three thousand li at thirty-five taels.
translations.idiomatic: Exile commutation added five taels per grade, reaching thirty-five taels for three-thousand-li exile.

sentences.zh: 遣刑與滿流同科。

translations.literal: Deportation was assessed at the same rate as full statutory exile.
translations.idiomatic: Deportation was commuted at the same rate as full statutory exile.

sentences.zh: 絞、斬則收贖銀四十兩。

translations.literal: Strangulation and decapitation commuted for forty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Strangulation and decapitation could be commuted for forty taels.

sentences.zh: 亦分注於各刑條下。

translations.literal: These amounts were also noted separately under each punishment article.
translations.idiomatic: These amounts were noted in each relevant article.

sentences.zh: 然非例應收贖者，不得濫及也。

translations.literal: Yet those not eligible for statutory commutation by precedent could not be included indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: Those not statutorily eligible for commutation could not be included.

sentences.zh: 捐贖，據光緒二十九年刑部奏准照運糧事例，減半銀數，另輯為例。

translations.literal: Donation commutation, according to what the Board of Punishments memorialized and approved in the twenty-ninth year of Guangxu following the transport-grain precedent with halved silver amounts, was compiled separately as sub-statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Donation commutation, approved by the Board of Punishments in 1903 at half the transport-grain precedent rates, was compiled as separate sub-statutes.

sentences.zh: 其笞、杖雖不入正刑，仍留竹板，以備刑訊之用。

translations.literal: Although light-bamboo and stick punishments were no longer among the orthodox punishments, bamboo boards were retained for use in judicial interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Light-bamboo and stick penalties were no longer formal punishments, but bamboo boards were retained for judicial interrogation.

sentences.zh: 外此各刑具，盡行廢除，枷號亦一概芟削，刑制較為徑省矣。

translations.literal: Apart from this, all other penal implements were abolished, and wearing the cangue was cut away entirely—the penal system became considerably more streamlined.
translations.idiomatic: All other penal implements were abolished, cangue wearing eliminated entirely, and the penal system became considerably simpler.

sentences.zh: 惟就地正法一項，始自咸豐三年。

translations.literal: Only the item of summary execution on the spot began in the third year of Xianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Only summary execution on the spot dated from 1853.

sentences.zh: 時各省軍興，地方大吏，遇土匪竊發，往往先行正法，然後奏聞。

translations.literal: At that time warfare arose in the provinces; local grand officials, encountering bandits and thieves breaking out, often executed them on the spot first and memorialized afterward.
translations.idiomatic: With warfare spreading across the provinces, local officials often executed bandits summarily and reported afterward.

sentences.zh: 嗣軍務敉平，疆吏樂其便己，相沿不改。

translations.literal: Later, when military affairs were pacified, frontier officials found it convenient and continued the practice unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: After military affairs subsided, frontier officials found summary execution convenient and continued the practice.

sentences.zh: 光緒七八年間，御史胡隆洵、陳啟泰等屢以為言。

translations.literal: During the seventh and eighth years of Guangxu, censors Hu Longxun, Chen Qitai, and others repeatedly raised the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In 1881–1882 censors Hu Longxun, Chen Qitai, and others repeatedly protested the practice.

sentences.zh: 刑部聲請飭下各省，體察情形，仍照舊例解勘，分別題奏。

translations.literal: The Board of Punishments requested an order to the provinces to examine local conditions and revert to the old precedent of forwarding prisoners for investigation and memorializing separately.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Punishments urged the provinces to examine local conditions and restore the old practice of forwarding prisoners for review and separate memorialization.

sentences.zh: 嗣各督撫俱覆稱地方不靖，礙難規復舊制。

translations.literal: Later all governors-general and governors replied that the regions were unsettled and it was difficult to restore the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-general and governors replied that local unrest made restoring the old system impossible.

sentences.zh: 刑部不得已，乃酌量加以限制，如實系土匪、馬賊、游勇、會匪，方准先行正法，尋常強盜，不得濫引。

translations.literal: The Board of Punishments had no choice but to impose limits after deliberation: only when the case truly involved bandits, horse thieves, roaming soldiers, or secret-society members was prior summary execution permitted; ordinary armed robbers could not be cited indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Punishments reluctantly imposed limits: summary execution was permitted only for genuine bandits, horse thieves, roaming soldiers, or secret-society members—not ordinary robbers.

sentences.zh: 自此章程行，沿及國變，而就地正法之制，訖未之能革。

translations.literal: Once this regulation was in force, it continued through the change of dynasty, and the institution of summary execution on the spot was never abolished to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Once enacted, the regulation persisted through dynastic collapse, and summary execution was never abolished.
